newsitem.title: USA: San Antonio feeder cattle steady-up $3 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: San Antonio feeder cattle steady-up $3 - USDA.

text.p: Feeder steers and heifers under 500 lbs were mostly steady, over 500 lbs $1.00-$3.00 per cwt higher, USDA said. Feeder heifers over 500 lbs were steady to $2.00 higher, compared to last week, USDA said. Cattle and Calves- 2,428 Last week- 1,575 Last Year- 1,623.

Trade was active and demand good. Bulk of supply Medium and Large 1-2 500-900 lb feeder steers and heifers. Supply included around 2 percent slaughter cows and bulls, 65 percent feeder cattle over 600 lbs with balance mostly feeder cattle under 600 lbs.
Feeder Heifers - Medium and Large 1 - 600-700 lbs 74.00-78.00; 700-800 lbs 72.00-75.50. Medium and Large 1-2 - 600-700 lbs 68.50-73.00; pkg 767 lbs 70.00. Heiferettes - 703-740 lbs 60.50-68.00.
